title: Sparse Autoencoder Attribution Graphs Are Decided at the Margin
abstract: arXiv:2611.00606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attribution graphs over the features of sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are used to predict what an ablation does and are compared across training seeds. A TopK SAE keeps the largest preactivations at each token, and a feature's margin is its preactivation's distance to the cutoff. On five public TopK SAE pairs from three Pythia models, zeroing one feature moves a next layer feature across the cutoff in 0.74 of cases or more, and the crossings carry most of the response's energy. Over writes that scale a feature's code by three factors, the graph built on the features active beforehand has a median relative error of 0.247 or more. The margin graph adds the first order change to every preactivation and reranks, at the same cost, and errs by at most 0.033. At the median, the crossing features' decoded change is 1.24 times the model's own change in norm or more. Between seeds of one testbed, sparse maps between features explain 0.85 of a graph

translated_title: 稀疏自编码器归因图由边际决定
translated_abstract: 基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征的归因图被用于预测消融操作的效果，并在不同训练种子之间进行比较。TopK SAE 在每个 token 上保留最大的预激活值，而特征的“边际”是其预激活值到截断阈值的距离。在来自三个 Pythia 模型的五个公开 TopK SAE 对上，将一个特征置零会在至少 0.74 的情形中使下一层的某个特征跨过截断阈值，而这些跨越承载了响应的大部分能量。对于将某个特征的编码放大三倍的写入操作，基于先前激活特征构建的图的中位相对误差达到 0.247 或更高。而“边际图”方法为每个预激活添加一阶变化并重新排序，在相同计算成本下，误差至多为 0.033。在中位数上，跨越特征的解码变化在范数上达到模型自身变化的至少 1.24 倍。在同一测试床的不同种子之间，特征之间的稀疏映射可以解释一个图的 0.85。
tldr: 该论文揭示 TopK 稀疏自编码器的特征激活值常贴近截断阈值，导致传统归因图误差较大，并提出一种在相同计算成本下为每个预激活加入一阶变化并重新排序的“边际归因图”方法，将中位相对误差从 0.247 以上降至至多 0.033。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that TopK SAE feature activations often lie near the cutoff threshold, making standard attribution graphs inaccurate, and proposes a "margin graph" that adds first-order preactivation changes and reranks at the same cost, reducing median relative error from at least 0.247 to at most 0.033.
